subject: Capacity renewal and commitment shift — pools + large-model + reranker
messages:
From: Tom Evans <tom.evans@acme-retail.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@acme-retail.com
Date: Fri, 02 Mar 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Capacity renewal & new model rollout — Q2 committed expansion

Hi Stephanie,

We're kicking off our planning for the May renewal and want to surface two changes on our side that will affect committed capacity:

- We're planning to add a larger LLM for product summarization (50k context) that will increase per-request memory;
- We want to add a reranker step to the pipeline (inference-only, non-training) to improve precision on search results.

Today our Dedicated pools are 12x A100 equivalent. Based on initial tests, we expect a ~2.2x GPU cost uplift unless we change the model mix or add more reserved capacity. Procurement asked for a proposal that includes:

1) options for reserved pools (H100 vs A100),
2) throughput guarantees (p50/p95 latency at 8k context, targets),
3) term/commitment suggestions (12 vs 24 months) and pricing impact, and
4) a suggested migration plan with minimal downtime for the reranker rollout.

I attached the RFP summary (acme_rfp_q2.pdf). Can your team put together options and a preliminary SOW? Prefer a short call next week to discuss.

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Evans
Head of Search & Personalization
Acme Retail

(Attachment: acme_rfp_q2.pdf)

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
To: Tom Evans <tom.evans@acme-retail.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 02 Mar 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity renewal & new model rollout — Q2 committed expansion

Tom —

Thanks for the clear summary and the RFP. We're excited to help you through the renewal. High level options we recommend:

Option A — Conservative: keep current pool type, +30% reserved capacity (add 4x H100-equivalent), 12-month term
- Rationale: preserves unit cost, simpler migration, short-term flexibility
- SLA: 99.9% uptime; throughput target: 40k tokens/sec aggregate

Option B — Performance-forward (recommended): provision segregated pools
- 6x H100 pool dedicated to long-context model (50k), separate 4x A100 pool for reranker and short-context requests
- Term: 18 months recommended (staged discounts after 12 months)
- SLA: 99.95% with a 60ms p50 at 8k typical request size (reranker on separate pool to isolate tail latency)

Option C — Cost-optimized: 12-month commit + aggressive quantization profile for reranker (mixed Q4/Q8) and caching for prefix-heavy flows

Immediate next steps we suggest:
- Sync call Monday 2028-03-06 to align on preferred option and baseline throughput;
- Draft SOW and amendment with model-mix appendix (deliverable: SOW-Acme-ReservedPools-2028.pdf).

Attachments: redwood_draft_proposal_v1.pdf (high-level pricing + pool diagrams).

I'll include Marissa and Karthik to confirm feasibility and sizing. Dylan can help with migration runbook once we lock the plan.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive — Dedicated
Redwood Inference

(Attachment: redwood_draft_proposal_v1.pdf)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Evans <tom.evans@acme-retail.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Mar 2028 14:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity renewal & new model rollout — Q2 committed expansion

Stephanie / team —

Quick technical notes after an initial sizing pass (referencing Tom's RFP and Steph's options):

- Long-context model (50k): requires ~80GB context RAM per instance with KV-cache; recommend H100-class instances for memory headroom. Expect peak GPU memory per replica ~72-78GB.
- Reranker: small model size but high QPS; better to colocate on separate pool sized for low-latency burst (4x A100-equivalent with continuous batching).
- Autoscale + warm KV cache: suggest a warm pool minimum of 2 replicas for the long-context cluster to avoid cold start penalties on first requests after idle.
- Quantization: we can use mixed int8 for reranker to cut token cost ~30% without measurable precision loss in acme tests. We'll prepare a test run to validate.

Ask: Tom — would you be open to a staged rollout where we first start a 4-rep H100 pilot for the 50k model for 30 days (telemetry review) before scaling to the full 6-rep pool? That would reduce initial commit and speed time-to-value.

I'll draft the migration runbook (low-downtime rolling deploy + fallback to short-context fallback model) and the perf validation checklist.

-- Marissa
Director, Platform Solutions
Redwood Inference

Appreciate quick confirmation.
